limits: Source-inspired authored common geometry, not recovered original surfaces. Hidden rear windows use an inferred fixed layout.
Window panes are opaque painted blue reflections; curved roof tiles and planter foliage use genuine segmented surfaces.
AABB joints are not exact collision certification; saved straight edges do not certify curves, short details, all internal lines or art95.
Saved floor and exposed boundary samples only, not every interior line. AABB joins do not certify all mesh intersections.
